newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares mixed in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares mixed in dull trade.

text.p: Lithuanian shares were mixed in dull trade on Thursday but dealers said gains were possible in the near future.
The group A index slipped 21.03 points to 2,398.30 in central market trade of only 874,000 litas.
"The market is dragging now, and it is hard to say which way it will go," one dealer told Reuters.
"But prices are down and demand is increasing, so it looks like trade and prices are set to pick up a little," he added. "There are some good buys right now."
Thursday's set-backs included Lithuanian Gas, which fell 1.90 percent to 2.06 litas in trade of 70,500 litas.
Rokishkis Cheese slipped 5.19 percent to 45.50 litas in trade of over 60,000 litas.
Hermis Bank was unchanged at 200 litas and 76,000 litas worth of its shares were traded while Ukio Bank rose 2.70 percent to 19.01 litas in trade of 152,000 litas.
Block trades worth over 440,000 litas were also made on Thursday while volume on the secondary T-bill market reached over four million litas.
